excluded_scope.reason: These are generated deliverables, not input records; they must not be mistaken for canonical product documentation.

limitations: Three local files drifted after P2; two P2 old byte variants could not be reconstructed locally, so their detailed heading/link fields are null rather than guessed.

P4 jest snapshotem punktu w czasie; live readback źródeł kanonicznych wykonano ponownie.

Pakiet nie dowodzi live działania serwera, runtime ani publikacji.
